manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Bladewing the Risen by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Bladewing the Risen trigger, choosing not to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bladewing the Risen.
Put the original Bladewing the Risen into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the token Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bladewing the Risen from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put the original Bladewing the Risen into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the nontoken Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bladewing the Risen from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 7.
